title: Grateful Dead Live at Hill Auditorium on 1971-12-14
lineage: 7in BBD reel> PCM501ES(beta)> PCM501ES analog out> Fostex D5 @ optical out 48KHz> HD; DAT-1 > Soundforge 4.5 > WAV/SHN

ai_review.summary: A crystal‑clear Betty Cantor soundboard capture of a high‑energy late‑1971 Ann Arbor show featuring smoking versions of Sugaree, Mr. Charlie, The Other One and Wharf Rat.
ai_review.review: The recording is an outstanding Betty Cantor soundboard mix – every instrument sits perfectly with crisp drums and brilliant piano/organ balance. Musically the band is in top form: tight first‑set playing gives way to a marathon Other One suite and a soaring Wharf Rat, with Jerry’s voice, Phil’s bass runs and Keith’s expressive keys all shining. Overall the show feels like one of the peak moments of the 1971 period.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 90 % of reviews are 5‑star, consistently praising both the superb soundboard mix and the show’s high energy and standout performances; only a single low‑rating comment is unrelated to performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Betty Cantor board, crisp and clear throughout; every instrument – especially Bill's drums – is well defined. Minor tape‑glitches noted by a few reviewers but they do not detract from the overall superb fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, well‑structured first set leading into an expansive second set with seamless transitions (NFA → GDTRFB, Cryptical → Drumz → Other One). The marathon Other One suite and the climactic Wharf Rat provide a powerful arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals are among his best; guitar tone is sweet on the Strat, interweaving leads with Bob during Truckin' and strong solo work throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass runs are angular and powerful, especially in the middle jam of The Other One suite.
band_member_comments.Bob: Rhythmic playing is funky and tight; shares lead moments with Jerry on Truckin'.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux delivers delicate, expressive piano/organ work; Pigpen’s soulful organ and vocal contributions (e.g., Mr. Charlie, Black Peter) are highlighted.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann's drums are crystal clear in the mix, driving the band with a swinging, tight feel.
